summary: Enhance your leadership skills with this Strategic Leadership and Governance Training. Gain insights and tools for effective decision-making and governance.
lede: Corporate governance helps board directors and strategy, risk, and governance professionals align oversight with organizational goals. The course addresses the practical task of turning board priorities into accountable execution through drafting board charters, tracking performance with scorecards, and building enterprise risk registers; learners also work on stakeholder engagement and ESG reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, or overseeing corporate governance and strategic execution within their organizations.
modules: Foundations of Corporate Governance and Board Oversight
ESG Mandates and Sustainable Value Creation
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 5 years of management experience and a foundational understanding of corporate structures and executive reporting. No advanced financial modeling or coding skills are required, but familiarity with basic enterprise risk concepts and strategic planning terminology will be highly beneficial.
